python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

changelog = Path("CHANGELOG.md")
text = changelog.read_text()
entry = ("## Unreleased\n"
         "- Add `Stock.restock(sku, qty)`, which adds a positive quantity and returns the new level.\n\n")
marker = "## 0.4.0\n"
assert marker in text and "## Unreleased" not in text
changelog.write_text(text.replace(marker, entry + marker, 1))

pyproject = Path("pyproject.toml")
text = pyproject.read_text()
assert 'version = "0.4.0"' in text
pyproject.write_text(text.replace('version = "0.4.0"', 'version = "0.5.0"', 1))
PY
sed -n '1,12p' CHANGELOG.md
sed -n '1,5p' pyproject.toml
